addictionPotential: 无成瘾性且滥用潜力低。
summary: 一种苯乙胺家族中流行的迷幻剂。低剂量带来共情体验，高剂量产生强烈视觉与迷幻体验。作为派对药物常见，因为比多数迷幻剂更清醒。2C-B 自 1990 年代初开始使用。
effectsSummary: Perceptions and feelings become more intense. From 10-15 mg (snorted already from 5 mg) there may be visual hallucinations such as bright colors, geometric patterns, image distortions. At 20-25 mg the hallucinations become more intense and ego dissolution may be experienced. Doses above 25 mg often lead to a complete loss of self.
dosageRemark: 2C-B is effective even in small doses; a gradual approach to the individual dose is recommended.
generalRisks: The pupils dilate, blood pressure rises and nausea, sweating and dizziness may occur. The body temperature rises; overheating must be avoided.
longtermRisks: There are no research results on long-term risks so far.
saferUse: 2C-B seems very setting-dependent and is only suitable for parties to a limited extent.
